items.evidence: apiLevel 2.13 with metadata; all volumes (5, 4, 1 µL) go through the p20 within 1–20 µL, and the simulator ran with no overdispense or empty-well checks failing.
Master mix is distributed with one tip (new_tip='once'), and primers and template use new_tip='always'. The tip_before_aspirate, tip_dropped_at_end and no_cross_contamination checks all pass.

The cycling program uses a 5 min initial denaturation and 35 cycles, which departs from the Q5 manufacturer's 30 s start and about 30 cycles. The code also adds an invented manual spin-down step and assumes the primer plate is pre-diluted.
Each well gets 5 µL 2x Q5 master mix (1x final), 4 µL of its primer pair and 1 µL colony template, added in that order. That makes a 10 µL reaction, matching the paper's OT-2 volume.
colony_plate.wells()[:96], primer_plate.wells()[:96] and pcr_plate.wells()[:96] are paired by index in the transfers, so A1 maps to A1 and so on, with no well skipped or reused.
A comment records sealing and a program of 98 °C initial denaturation, 35 cycles of 98/60/72 °C, 72 °C final extension and a 4 °C hold, which is suitable for Q5 Hot Start.

judge.summary: The protocol sets up the 96 reactions correctly: 5 µL 2x master mix, 4 µL primer pair and 1 µL template per well, with correct well mapping and tip handling, and the simulator checks pass. It fails the all-or-nothing fidelity item because of deviations in the cycling program (5 min initial denaturation, 35 cycles) and an invented spin-down step.
